title: Finn
tagline: Create bucket of tokens and diversify your portfolio efficiently
description:
The micromanagement of token portfolios for DeFi users is quite time-consuming and has bad UX. To invest in a bunch of tokens, Finn comes hand-in-hand with creating buckets consisting of tokens on multiple networks and investing in buckets with good market performance. It streamlines the process of investment with overall balanced high returns. Well, users can get heavy incentives for the usage of their buckets by consumers. It’s a mutual fund aggregator in Web3 built on top of 1inch and deployed on Arbitrum One, Base, Polygon Mainnet and Scroll Sepolia. There are other features as well:

1. **Deposit/Withdraw**: It clones the bucket and provides customization in the deposit. Withdraw the funds anytime at the current market price to receive returns
2. **Analytics**: It shows the profit/loss wrt. timestamp of investment in a created bucket as well as bucket details in the profile section.
3. **Privacy**: Well it asks the user whether to create a bucket private or public for their benefits and requirements. The private listings won’t appear publicly.

**Links**
- [https://eth-finn.vercel.app/](https://eth-finn.vercel.app/)
how_its_made:
We couldn’t able to swap the small amount using Fusion API and there is no API for allowance in swap. Thus, we wrote our API for allowance.

Our smart contract was not able to deploy on Arbitrum One due to some opcode error. We would like to support the tokens on multiple network.
